professionalSummary.text: Product manager with four years of experience leading the integrations area of a developer analytics suite, responsible for product requirements, discovery, backlog prioritisation, and adoption reporting.
professionalSummary.witness: Product manager for the integrations area of a developer analytics suite for four years, writing the product requirements for the source control and ticketing integrations and running discovery calls with engineering leaders at twenty customer accounts.

experienceHighlights.text: Authored product requirements for source control and ticketing integrations and conducted discovery calls with engineering leaders at 20 customer accounts.
experienceHighlights.witness: writing the product requirements for the source control and ticketing integrations and running discovery calls with engineering leaders at twenty customer accounts.

experienceHighlights.text: Prioritised the integrations backlog using the suite’s weighted scoring method and maintained scoring sheets and quarterly roadmap reviews.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prioritised the integrations backlog with the integrations feature team under the suite's weighted scoring method, with the scoring sheets and the quarterly roadmap reviews filed in the product folder.

experienceHighlights.text: Reported integration adoption quarterly to leadership and documented roadmap boundaries for the integrations area.
experienceHighlights.witness: Reported integration adoption to the leadership team each quarter and wrote the roadmap boundary note for the integrations area, listing what the area would not build in the coming two quarters.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided product requirements for a ticketing integration, a weighted scoring sheet for a quarter, and an adoption report, all stored in the product folder.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the product requirements for the ticketing integration, the weighted scoring sheet for one quarter and the adoption report for the same quarter, with the product folder references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Product strategy, discovery, backlog prioritisation, roadmap management, cross‑functional collaboration with engineering, commercial, and customer success teams.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish four years of product management experience in the integrations area, evidence of discovery, backlog prioritisation, adoption reporting, and contribution to pricing discussions, but do not confirm seven years of product management or that the candidate set pricing independently without a senior product manager.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate meets several key requirements but lacks evidence for seven years of product management and independent pricing ownership.

evidence.notes: Years include business analyst role; pricing ownership unclear.
